steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Radio is a broadcast medium that uses sound codes (speech, music, sound effects, silence) to communicate with audiences. It is immediate, intimate, and portable.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: BBC Radio operates under public service obligations, providing distinctive programming for diverse audiences. BBC Radio 1 targets young audiences; Radio 4 targets older, educated listeners.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Commercial radio (Global, Bauer) is funded by advertising. It targets specific demographics to maximise ad revenue — e.g. Heart targets 25-44 women, LBC targets news-interested adults.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Radio conventions: scheduling, jingles, station identification, news bulletins, phone-ins, playlists, presenters, and audience interaction (texts, calls, social media).
